company_description: Mid-large financial services firm exploring LLM for customer support automation and regulatory summarization. Heavy security and residency constraints; procurement driven. Large existing vendor relationships.
notes: Deal declared closed-lost 2024-10-28 — chose OpenAI Direct API for initial roll-out.
Primary reasons cited by buyer: simplicity of integration, brand familiarity, existing legal precedent with OpenAI, and faster POC timeline.
Auric team liked Redwood's cost controls and routing ideas but perceived integration overhead for VPC/on-prem as higher than direct API trial.
Security team pushed for more mature vendor attestations; procurement prioritized speed of delivery over deeper platform features.
No single internal champion — ML engineering team split; product prioritized quick pilot with ChatComms team.
Budget freeze at enterprise IT level delayed decisioning; procurement accepted lower-risk vendor with a simple contract to avoid delay.
Quote from Head of AI: 'We need something working in 2 weeks — brand + SDK wins this time.'
AE note: Good technical fit for Dedicated/Private long-term; short-term inertia favored OpenAI/Anthropic.
Recommend maintaining quarterly security updates and one-pager on migration path from OpenAI to Redwood Dedicated when residency required.

poc_summary: Redwood proposed Dedicated cluster in NA region with KMS integration, automatic prefix caching, and fine-grained audit logs. POC would demonstrate chat latency <150ms p50 and cost reduction vs baseline. Auric requested 30-day POC; later shortened by procurement to 2 weeks — mismatch on delivery expectations.
decision_reason: Chose OpenAI direct API: fastest path to pilot, strong brand confidence across product/procurement, simpler legal terms for an initial pilot. Security accepted temporary use under tight data minimization policy.

One-page TCO comparison vs direct APIs with migration path to Dedicated/Private.
Targeted outreach to Head of AI in 6 months or after regulation change.
Offer migration credits/discounts if they revisit Dedicated within 12 months.
